title: The sidebar's git panel runs no program a site's repository names, and never reads or writes a repository outside the session workspace
steps: S1: In vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar run the vitest files tests/git-safe.spec.ts (one planted `touch <marker>` per vector: fsmonitor, include/includeIf, worktree config, clean/smudge filters, textconv/external diff, hooks/hooksPath, gpg, merge drivers, pager/editor/askPass/sshCommand/credential helper, submodule config, linked worktrees; plus the single-spawn source test) and tests/git-fence.spec.ts (pointer file, .git symlink, core.worktree, commondir, alternates, symlinked refs, ancestor repository, outside linked worktree; a fingerprinted victim repository outside).
expect: S1: both files pass: no marker is ever created, panel data stays correct, every redirect is refused with the victim unchanged, and a normal repository / inside worktree / nested cwd still work.
evidence: 09/10/2026, PR #1094: a scratch repo with core.fsmonitor = "touch marker" made the fork's status() run it inside the host's shared dsh process.
fence: Repository-controlled execution and repository discovery of the fork's in-process git. Residual: a symlink swapped between the check and git's use (milliseconds) — only running git in the site container closes it.
